'''Lexi Dio''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I just about shrieked out my larynx seeing Lexi Dio’s atrocious frock. She was bedecked in a layered accident that superlatives absolutely fail. She was beyond tacky. She was infratacky, of a variety visible only to bees and bats.|Dyslogia Twang|<ref name="Sightings by Twain">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|life/13425_1.html|SPECIAL FEATURE: Sightings by Twang}}</ref>}}
[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Dio represented the Mid Rim [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] of [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]], and was a member of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]].<ref name="Hnn-Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}}</ref> She was surrounded by a group of Uyter-born [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], including [[Half'pelt Sen]], [[Benet Pryer]], [[Tavah Whey Term]] and [[Mages Jink]].<ref name="FF130">{{FactFile|130|DIO 1-2|Lexi Dio}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Senator Dio attended a [[Refugee Relief Movement fundraiser|fundraiser]] in favor of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] held at the [[Xenvaer Civic Auditorium]] on [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. The [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Dyslogia Twang]] described her look as "atrocious" and "''infra''tacky".<ref name="Sightings by Twain" />

She was strongly opposed to the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], as the people she represented were apprehensive about giving so much power to the central government.<ref name="FF130" />

Dio was in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] retransmitted a message sent by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to warn the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had built an [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]] of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

During the Clone Wars, Senator Dio continued to oppose increasing the power of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], especially in the crisis following the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="HNN 15:3:29" /> Sometime later, she was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] and replaced by [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]].<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lexi Dio was portrayed by [[Nicole Fantl]]. In the [[2009]] [[Star Wars Annual 2009|''Star Wars Annual'']], her name is misspelled as "Lexie Dio".
